Name: JP's Farms - Bigger Farm (Redux) - Big Farm
Author: juanpa98ar
Description:
[font=Georgia][center][b][i][color=#00ff00][size=6]
[u]Bigger Standard farm Redux[/u][/size][/color][/i][/b][/center]

[b][i][size=4]This is an improved and lighter version of the original mod [/size][/i][/b][b][i][size=4][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2443]Bigger Standard Map[/url]. Fixed some bugs and is now compatible with other mods such as Stardew Valley Expanded (You will no longer appear in the middle of the farm if you enter through Marnie's ranch).[/size][/i][/b]


[b][i][color=#00ffff][size=6][u]Map Features:[/u][/size]
[/color][/i][/b]
[list]
[*][b][size=4]The entire site is fully functional[/size][/b]
[*][b][size=4]It is twice the size of the normal farm, maybe more.[/size][/b]
[*][b][size=4]The ponds were removed and a new one was placed behind the house.[/size][/b]
[*][b][size=4]Added four rice ponds to the left side of the farm (Optional, configurable).[/size][/b]
[*][b][size=4]Added a teleport from the statue near the pet bowl to the other end of the farm (Optional, configurable).[/size][/b]
[*][b][size=4]Some extra decorations.[/size][/b]
[/list][b][i][size=6]
[color=#ffff00][u]Installation:[/u][/color][/size]
[/i][/b]
[/font][b][size=4][font=Georgia]Download the mod, unzip it in the Mods folder of the game. Configure it with the mod [/font][font=Georgia][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]. Check the mod requirements.
